title: Local uniform continuity of the second derivative of a C^2 function
statement: Let E be a real normed space (E : Type with NormedAddCommGroup E and NormedSpace ℝ E) and F : E -> R of class C^2 (ContDiff ℝ 2 F). For every x0 in E and every delta > 0 there is eps > 0 such that, for all x in E with ||x - x0|| <= eps and all Q, Q' in E, |D^2F(x)[Q][Q'] - D^2F(x0)[Q][Q']| <= delta (||Q|| ||Q'||), where D^2F(x)[Q][Q'] = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) x Q Q'.
lean_statement: ∀ {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (F : E → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 2 F → ∀ x₀ : E, ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ x : E, ‖x - x₀‖ ≤ ε → ∀ Q Q' : E, |fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) x Q Q' - fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) x₀ Q Q'| ≤ δ * (‖Q‖ * ‖Q'‖)
